stages.title: Measure the door before making it
stages.description: The divider depends on the ceiling, the bar end and the back of the bar. Check all three first.
actions: Measure the ceiling where the divider stands, at both ends and in the middle. The model uses measured 2,630 mm; the crates and lintel heights are derived from it.
Confirm the bar end at x 1,292 mm and bar back at y 2,280 mm from the walls. These come from the CAD model, not a site survey.
Find out what the ceiling is made of. Four ties fix into it; concrete, hollow blocks and a suspended ceiling each need a different answer.
Check the right wall for pipes and cables at the four divider wall ties.
Mock up the door with tape: 1,360 mm at its widest, 869 mm at the floor, 1,990 mm high.
notes: This is a checked geometry proposal, not a certified load rating or a drilling template. The ceiling ties are drawn, not designed: have them checked.

stages.title: Lay out the kit
stages.description: Sort pipes by their printed lengths. There are many more T connectors than in V18.
actions: Use only the listed DOLLE PIPE family; do not mix generic plumbing threads or change a stock pipe length.
Sort 137 sliding T connectors by post before starting. Each post carries its own stack.
Dry-fit one T/pipe/saddle/board connection, and measure the seating stops into the fitting profile.
Assemble cross-pipe modules while the T sleeves are free, then feed the posts through. Do not try to screw a rigid closed frame together.

stages.title: Stage the divider posts
stages.description: Six new posts join the two near desk posts, which finish the rear row at the wall end.
actions: Set out post centres at x 1,343, 1,633, 3,085 and 3,375 mm, in two rows at y 1,960 and 2,250 mm. The desk posts take the last two rear positions, so nothing is doubled.
Load every sleeve for the 1,000 mm lower section before closing it into its coupling.
Use floor protection under flanges. The frame is not self-supporting until it is tied to the wall and ceiling.

stages.title: Complete the divider posts
stages.description: 1,500 mm upper sections finish well below the ceiling, so the posts stay uncut stock.
actions: Load the upper sleeves, then close each post through its coupling.
Posts top out at about 2,027 mm. The gap to the ceiling is taken up by the sliding T ties, not by cutting a pipe.
Keep the frame loosely propped until the ties are in.

stages.title: Fit the tower cross-pipes
stages.description: Each shelf level hangs on 250 mm cross-pipes between the front and rear posts.
actions: Fit cross-pipes at 85, 315, 565, 865, 1,175, 1,430, 1,655 mm for the stepped shelves. Levels with a long overhang use arms instead on the inner posts.
Fit the lintel cross-pipes at 2,015 and 2,305 mm on all four post pairs, and the tie cross-pipes at 2,395 mm.
Each T has a single branch, so two pipes can never share one sleeve.

stages.title: Tie it to the ceiling and wall
stages.description: Four ceiling ties and four wall ties stop the divider from tipping.
actions: Slide a T onto each tie cross-pipe, fit the 200 mm pipe and bring its flange to the ceiling at 2,630 mm.
Because the T slides, a slightly different ceiling moves the tie rather than changing a pipe.
Fit the wall ties at 940 and 1,760 mm on the front post and the rear desk post of the wall-side pair.
Square the frame and check it is plumb before fitting any boards.
notes: Ceiling construction and fixings are unknown. No load capacity is implied by this model.

stages.title: Hang the stepped shelves
stages.description: This is where the door appears: each board stops at the curve.
actions: Fit the 14 boards at underside heights 100, 330, 580, 880, 1,190, 1,445, 1,670 mm, left and right.
Transfer the 44 mm post bores and shallow T reliefs from the real frame. Do not trust the preview numbers.
Cut the inner ends last, against a full-size template of the opening. Left and right mirror each other.
At 315 mm the right-hand shelf reuses the desk's low brace as its rear support, so only a front pipe is added.
The top level sits on capped arms. Keep it to light things: no books, no plants that need watering overhead.
notes: The arms are cantilevers with no manufacturer rating, as on the speaker trays.

stages.title: Close the crown
stages.description: Two short floating steps finish the top of the circle.
actions: Fit each board on two capped arms and four saddles.
Underside height 1,805 mm. Check head room with the people who actually live here.
Keep these empty or nearly so.

stages.title: Build the crate band
stages.description: Two continuous boards carry all six crates above the door.
actions: Fit the lower lintel at 2,030 mm on its end pipes and the central rail, which is 1,200 + coupling + 200 mm between the inner cross-pipes.
Fit the upper lintel at 2,320 mm on its end pipes only: a rail there would run straight through the crates.
Each board has eight post bores. A 2,092 mm oak board is long; check you can get it into the flat before ordering.
Check a real crate on the board: 460 × 310 × 250 mm between the inner posts, with 32 mm left above the top row.
notes: The door head is 1,990 mm, set by the oak light cover. A lower ceiling lowers it too.

stages.title: Stage the desk and wardrobe posts
stages.description: The whole desk module stands behind the divider, unchanged.
actions: The desk block moves 950 mm toward the balcony compared with V18, as one rigid unit, until its near posts are the rear divider row.
Those two posts carry both sets of sleeves. Stage them from the full list; their lower parts are the crowded ones.
Their wall ties move to the divider heights, and they run on above the desk to reach the ceiling ties.
Stage the lower sleeves and braces before closing each lower post.

stages.title: Build the shared desk supports
stages.description: The same joints as V18: a rear cross line at 235 mm, a front brace at 400 mm and the desk-height crosses.
actions: Low line first: a 200 mm tube and a four-female cross at 235 mm on each rear post, with a 250 mm pipe to a sliding T on the middle post and a 40 mm pipe into a wall flange. The rear posts continue with a 1,000 mm tube.
Preassemble each cross/front-arm/elbow module with its 40 mm pipe, coupling and 602 mm front leg, and brace the leg to the middle post with a 250 mm sliding-T bridge at 400 mm.
Fit the desk-height cross at each middle upright with its 250 mm front arm and rear bridge.

materials.name: Four-way threaded cross
materials.sku: 96384 / EAN 4007557096384 — UNCONFIRMED: Bauhaus SE lists this EAN as a 4×3/4" corner coupling

stages.title: Fit the desktop and service shelf
stages.description: The same 1,615 × 702 mm surface, with its R100 corner now facing the door.
actions: Fit the desktop around the continuing posts and screw it to its eight saddle tabs.
Hang the rear service shelf on four separate wall shelf brackets (allowance); it is not part of the pipe frame.
The rounded corner sits on your way through the door. 778 mm is left between it and the left edge of the opening at the floor.

stages.title: Complete the upper posts
stages.description: Feed the pre-staged sleeves before closing the desk and wardrobe posts.
actions: Ordinary wardrobe posts use 1000 + coupling + 1200 mm. The rear wall-side desk posts use 1000 + coupling + 1200 mm (near) and 1000 + coupling + 1000 mm (far) above their low cross. The near middle post continues with 602 + coupling + 1200 mm above its riser; the far one keeps its 1500 mm tube.
Keep couplings fully seated; never leave a tube partly threaded to adjust the height.

stages.title: Square and brace the frame
stages.description: Tie the desk and wardrobe back to the wall.
actions: Install the upper wall ties at their model heights.
Fit the wardrobe depth bars, including the 1,800 mm coat-end brace.
Check verticals and diagonals, then secure the verified fasteners.
notes: Wall material and permissible fixings remain to be verified.

stages.title: Fit the hanging rails
stages.description: One short bay with two rails, and one coat bay.
actions: Fit the 602 mm rails at 950 and 1,950 mm in the short bay, and at 2,030 mm in the coat bay.
The coat rail sits 80 mm higher because both rails meet at one post, and two sleeves cannot share a height.
About seven short garments fit per rail and four coats. That is less hanging space than V18.

stages.title: Add the shelves
stages.description: Cross-pipes, desk shelves and wardrobe tops.
actions: Build the listed 250 mm cross-pipe modules before closing the post sections.
Fit the three 1,554 × 350 mm desk shelves at 1,540, 1,880 and 2,190 mm.
Fit the two 606 mm wardrobe tops and the low shoe shelf at 200 mm.
Keep opposing saddle tabs staggered on shared pipes.

stages.title: Float and angle the speakers
stages.description: Unchanged from V18, just further along the wall.
actions: Attach each tray to two uncut 250 mm arms, each on a sliding T at a separate upright.
Fit four saddle holders per tray, using the rotated screw layout from the model.
Tilt each speaker down on angled isolation pads.
notes: No load rating for this cantilever arrangement has been established.

stages.title: Close the post ends
stages.description: Only close the posts after every sleeve and board is in place.
actions: Fit the end covers after confirming their fit on this thread family. Covers carry no load.
Recheck every socket, coupling, tie and saddle screw.

stages.title: Light the door
stages.description: The 960 mm bar and its oak cover turn 90° and sit over the opening.
actions: Fit the 960 mm ÖVERSIDAN under the lower lintel behind its oak cover, on the kitchen side.
Fit two 460 mm bars under the top full shelves, left and right.
Keep the other bars as in V18. Nine bars on the 30 W driver come to about 27.7 W, so check the driver rating.
Keep drivers accessible; do not enclose mains equipment.
notes: Bar wattages are scaled from V18 by length. Check the printed rating of each bar.

stages.title: Add crates and clothes
stages.description: Fill the band above the door, and move the folded clothes onto the shelves.
actions: Slide the six KNAGGLIG crates onto the lintels, three across and two high. There is 32 mm above the top row, so they go in flat rather than tilted.
Crates are heavy overhead. Keep heavy things in the lower row, and secure the top row.
Stack folded clothes in the tower bays between the posts: eight stacks of three across the two towers.
Fit the equipment as in V18: Mac mini and router on the service shelf, Focusrite and dock under the front ends.
Park the chair well under the desk when you are not using it.
extra: Reused M1 Mac mini, router, OWC dock and two-input Focusrite
Removable equipment straps and cable clips

stages.title: Walk through the real room
stages.description: A physical fit check completes the concept review.
actions: Walk through the door carrying something. 869 mm at the floor, 1,122 mm at shoulder height, 778 mm to the desk corner.
Sit at the desk and check the aisle beside the bed: 930 mm with the chair parked, less when seated.
Open the right balcony leaf and check its handle, curtains and coats.
Have the ceiling and wall fixings checked before loading the crates or shelves.
notes: The bathroom is only a shell because its fixtures are unknown.
